name: ClimSim Low-Resolution Real-Geography Dataset
size_as_stated: 69,783,552 samples for the training data (235.2 GB), 1,564,086 samples for the validation data (4.7 GB), and 1,681,920 samples for the test data (5.5 GB)
resolution: 11.5° × 11.5° (384 columns on ne4pg2 cubed-sphere grid), 60 vertical levels, 20 min timestep; embedded 2D CRM with 64 columns at 2 km horizontal grid spacing

scales.note: ClimSim 10-year simulation on ne4pg2 grid (11.5 degrees horizontal resolution, ~1276.5 km) with embedded 2 km 2D CRM; data sampled at 20-min timestep (up to 12-timestep subsampling for testing); preprocessed data sizes sum to 245.4 GB.
